lines.say: modeled on epithalamin, an extract of cattle pineal glands
melatonin rose to age-typical levels in 40 women with low levels (small trial)
evening melatonin rose over fourfold in older monkeys (monkey study)
the melatonin trial didn't measure sleep; FDA found no evidence it helps insomnia
activates telomerase (lab studies), which FDA says could cause cancer long term
possible immune reactions to the peptide or its impurities and clumps, FDA says

ask: Does my personal or family cancer history change the picture, given the telomerase concern?
